name: Cookiy
description: Cookiy is a Claude Code plugin for end-to-end user research. It provides skills to design research plans, screening questionnaires, and discussion guides; analyze and synthesize raw interview notes or transcripts into evidence-backed reports; and—when using Cookiy AI—run AI-moderated qualitative interviews and quantitative surveys with recruitment and reporting. Use it whenever the task involves user research, customer discovery, interview guides, surveys, or research synthesis.
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install cookiy@claude-community` from `cookiy-ai/user-research-skill` (`plugins/user-research`).

Cookiy is a Claude Code plugin for end-to-end user research. It provides skills to design research plans, screening questionnaires, and discussion guides; analyze and synthesize raw interview notes or transcripts into evidence-backed reports; and—when using Cookiy AI—run AI-moderated qualitative interviews and quantitative surveys with recruitment and reporting. Use it whenever the task involves user research, customer discovery, interview guides, surveys, or research synthesis.
